title: One step of the silent return machine
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, let $\mathrm{cap}$ be a distinguished $k$-tape index, and let $M$ be an $m$-tape machine. For any initial tape contents and head positions, prefix and initial output, and configuration $c$ whose state is present, one step of the return machine from the embedded configuration with state mapped into the left summand equals the return-state embedding of the configuration reached by one step of $M$ from $c$.
